data.narrative:
Notus Autonomous Systems is a Seed-stage Defense & Security company founded by Emmanuel Margolin and Arhum Jain, having raised $500K to date. The valuation analysis draws on a comparable universe of 10 private and 2 public firms operating in the same sector and stage cohort, including peers such as UFORCE, Stark Defence, Castelion, Singularity, and NODA AI.

Two triangulation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis uses the $500K raised as a proxy baseline and applies a 2.5x multiplier typical of Seed-to-next-stage advancement, yielding $1.25M. The peer-median approach examines five same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables with valuations ranging from $125M (NODA AI, Series A) to $4.0B (Stark Defence, Series A), producing a median valuation of $1.0B. These divergent results reflect the substantial dispersion within the Defense & Security startup landscape.

The two methods triangulate to a range of $1.06B (low) to $1.15B (high), with a median of $501M. The wide spread between stage-progression ($1.25M) and peer-median ($1.0B) reflects material uncertainty around whether comparable peer valuations represent appropriate anchors for an early-stage, pre-revenue or early-revenue entrant. Key uncertainties include Notus's actual revenue traction, technical differentiation relative to the peer set, and the sustainability of valuations across the $125M–$4.0B range observed in comparables. Stage-specific metrics and founder track record would further refine this assessment.
